mechanism: Reuse the existing compact-predecessor PC chain engine for the DNA route with exactly one additional older candidate after the nearest six-byte match. Preserve65536heads, denseDNA insertion, no-fold emission, skip/lazy budgets and byte validation. dp=1 means two total candidates, not three.
difference_from_old_work: AQ measured96908length6matches and26237length7matches in the original DNA parse; most accepted matches are short. This tests better match choice from one older occurrence while preserving low token count, rather than flooding the encoder with literals. It changes matcher capability and memory state; existing PC family proof reuse is only a draft for this exact route.

attribution.reuse: Existing pc_run1c and compact predecessor mechanism; not an independently invented chain engine.
